name: Zypento Abandoned Cart Recovery
author: sproutient

sections.description:
Zypento Abandoned Cart Recovery is the ultimate WooCommerce abandoned cart recovery plugin.
Turn missed sales into revenue with smart, personalized abandoned cart recovery follow-ups.

Whether you’re running a small WooCommerce store or scaling a large eCommerce operation, recovering abandoned carts is critical. Zypento boosts your conversions, improves retention, and brings back lost customers — automatically.

Key Benefits of Zypento WooCommerce Abandoned Cart Recovery:

Detects abandoned cart and triggers recovery emails instantly.

Seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce stores.

Helps recover revenue and increase conversions around the clock.

Features:

Abandoned cart recovery for WooCommerce.

Automatically sends abandoned cart recovery emails based on cart behavior.

Easy setup — no complex abandoned cart recovery automation needed.

Converts lost carts into confirmed sales effortlessly.

External Services

This plugin connects to the zypento.com API to send automated cart recovery and review request emails.

This service is provided by “zypento.com”: terms of use, privacy policy.

CSS/JS source

Unminified CSS/JS are in assets/css/src and assets/js/src.

GitHub

https://github.com/sproutient/Zypento-Abandoned-Cart-Recovery/
Clone the repository, Then to compile css/js from source, run ‘composer install’ once and whenever you want to compile, run ‘composer create-scripts’
sections.installation:
Upload the Zypento abandoned cart recovery plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugin Installer.

Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' menu in WordPress.

Navigate to Dashboard > Zypento abandoned cart recovery to configure your Zypento API/Site key and enable abandoned cart recovery.
sections.faq:
How do I connect my zypento.com account?

Go to Dashboard > Zypento abandoned cart recovery, click the settings tab, and enter your Zypento API/Site key. This enables the plugin to send abandoned cart recovery emails via your Zypento account.

Do I need a zypento.com account to use this plugin?

Yes, an active zypento.com account with API access is required to use the abandoned cart recovery features.
